verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents a menu-driven way to create and run a Windows VM (Install > Windows), running through Docker with hardware virtualization, a shared clipboard and a shared folder, so little manual setup is needed. That capability covers only a Windows guest and requires a Windows 11 Pro license; there is no evidence of creating or running arbitrary VMs. Missing for 10: general-purpose VM creation for other guest OSes, documented setup steps beyond the Windows flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
